name: Sam Jackson
source:
Sam "Glass Jaw" Jackson has been the center of [url=/c176650]John[/url]'s universe since John was 11. He single-handedly put purpose in John's life and has been his father figure ever since. In his youth, Sam was a successful pro boxer in his own right, winning several professional bouts. The moniker "Glass Jaw" did not describe Sam, but his opponents that often looked like they hit the canvass from a pretty harmless blow. Sam's attention to detail was widely appreciated, and has made him an excellent coach.

[Edited from in-game description]
